subject.title: fix(ui): Realtime Talk hangs when Google Live connections stall

question: Should Google Live Realtime Talk enforce a 30-second deadline through provider `setupComplete`, accepting that an exceptionally slow setup is terminated and cleaned up instead of remaining Connecting?
rationale: The patch is a bounded bug fix, but the timeout deliberately defines a user-visible availability policy that cannot be settled from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the 30-second startup budget
options.body: Merge the bounded timeout and cleanup behavior, treating post-open setup that exceeds 30 seconds as a failed Google Live attempt.

options.title: Choose a different product budget
options.body: Keep the lifecycle design but request a different deadline only if maintainers have provider or support evidence that 30 seconds rejects valid setups.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second startup budget
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded timeout and cleanup behavior, treating post-open setup that exceeds 30 seconds as a failed Google Live attempt.
